title: fix(openai): support messages count_tokens dispatch
body:
## Summary
- Route OpenAI-backed Anthropic `/v1/messages/count_tokens` requests to the OpenAI gateway instead of returning 404.
- Return a local Anthropic Messages token estimate so Claude Code can size long-context GPT-5.5 conversations when users explicitly map Claude models to GPT-5.5.
- Keep existing default dispatch mappings unchanged; this PR only fixes compatibility for configured OpenAI-backed long-context models.

## Test plan
- [x] `GOPROXY=https://goproxy.cn,direct go test ./internal/server/routes ./internal/handler ./internal/service -count=1`
- [x] `pnpm --dir frontend typecheck` (not run: frontend dependencies were not installed locally)
